annotation.interpretation_a: The phrase "currently allowed" refers to the maximum Push ID value that has been advertised by the peer via a PUSH_PROMISE frame on this connection. Thus, a CANCEL_PUSH frame referencing a Push ID greater than any PUSH_PROMISE seen so far would trigger a connection error.
annotation.interpretation_b: The phrase "currently allowed" refers to the absolute maximum Push ID value permitted by the protocol (e.g., the largest value that can be encoded in the frame). Therefore, a CANCEL_PUSH frame referencing a Push ID exceeding that protocol‑defined maximum would trigger a connection error.
annotation.justification: The clause does not define "currently allowed", leaving it open to either interpretation of the allowed Push ID range.
